placements.why: All three segments thematically support the decision-capture-at-consensus narrative. src-1 reports shipping the async decision widget — the product embodiment of capturing decisions at the moment of consensus. src-3 identifies the Zephyr integration as the key unlock, i.e. the mechanism that enables cross-platform decision capture without separate plugins. src-2's velocity metric (23 points, highest this quarter) is a delivery fact that evidences successful execution of that capability. These are facts evidencing the narrative theme, not themes themselves — no new leaf is warranted.
